facts.fact: 舞会上她问：你会考虑住这种地方吗？——他答大概不会，最近的办公室要几小时车程；她心里判定：他爱他的生活多过爱我，没有未来
facts.anchor: they couldn’t be more different, and there was no future

facts.fact: 她独自到楼外哭：要给心里刚长出的希望一个了结
facts.anchor: Rick might want her, but he loved his life more.

facts.fact: 楼侧阴影里手捂上她的嘴：雪茄与皮革的味道像蟒蛇缠上——金发男自报 Johnny，就是 Elasia 被杀那晚在场的人
Johnny 调侃：Ansel 对你挺 sweet；「no woman is worth dying for」
facts.anchor: If Ansel found out I’d had you in my arms like that, he’d slit my throat

facts.fact: 威胁：别叫，否则我去看你朋友——没人会在意我尝她一口
Elasia 死因第一次被凶手侧证实：那晚不是关于你——她只是 wrong place wrong time
facts.anchor: It was pretty cute how puffed up she was

facts.fact: 真相：Wyatt 从他们那儿偷了十万美元以上——Elasia 死于男友是贼
facts.anchor: Your friend’s little FBI boyfriend was skimming from us

facts.fact: Jolene 用拐杖像球棒一样抡中 Johnny 的脸；她接过拐杖一顿抽：「You asshole!...Calling me a bitch?」
facts.anchor: swung it like a baseball bat

facts.fact: 她夸 Jolene 灵活，对方答每天早上还做 Jane Fonda 的体操
facts.anchor: I still do Jane Fonda’s calisthenics every morning.

facts.fact: Jolene 定调：没有比 Holiday 更安全的地方；若你跑、他们找到你，还是会来伤我们
结论：必须开镇民大会——「你误判了这个镇的人，我们绝不退缩」
facts.anchor: we are going to have to hold a town meeting
